title: Curate proteasome-inhibition and known-substrate MAPP panels for availability validation
body:
Parent #723 / #733; complements #752 (current MAPP source), #757 (parallel precursor proteome) and #739 (shared recipes).

## Concrete missing comparison

The first local Presto comparison trains exact and sampled policies on strict positive UT versus TNF+IFN captured-fragment compositions. Neither method improves held-out reverse KL over uniform, and predicted condition redistribution is nearly zero. That result does not tell us whether the limit is the model, the small selected cohort, treatment signal or observation noise. We need a source-backed positive control where processing machinery is directly perturbed and a known substrate produces identifiable fragments.

The [primary Wolf-Levy MAPP study](https://www.nature.com/articles/nbt.4279) reports cellular epoxomicin/Velcade experiments and a degron-linked ZsGreen substrate (Supplementary Figures 2–3). These are candidates for a more diagnostic comparison; availability of complete machine-readable peptide-level quantities and exact run mappings still needs verification. Current shared UT/TNF+IFN admission does not expose those comparisons. The already inventoried PRIDE projects and publisher assets should be checked before fetching duplicate inputs.

## Requested shared curation

1. Locate the original peptide-level results, raw acquisitions and acquisition-to-condition maps for the inhibitor and known-substrate panels. Publish a source inventory with accessible, restricted, absent and unresolved statuses; figure-level summaries alone are not per-peptide labels. Keep original project/run identifiers, bytes, hashes and citable locators.
2. Preserve measured cell species/type, substrate sequence/construct and degron, treatment target, compound, dose, duration, timing relative to lysis, untreated/untransfected controls, biological versus technical replicate assertions and exact specimen/aliquot links where supplied. A publication-level claim of biological replicates does not invent a run-to-specimen crosswalk.
3. Distinguish inhibition in living cells from protease inhibitors added during sample handling, and pharmacological intervention from gene KO. Keep MAPP capture/preservation controls separate from changes in APC machinery. Unknown activity is not wild type; molecular targets do not establish a measured residual activity fraction.
4. Preserve peptide intensity representation, capture target/antibody, beads/background filtering, search/detection scope, direct MS/MS versus matching, confidence level, missing/filtered/imputed states and complete contributor lineage. Keep nonbinding products; no affinity prefilter or missing-peptide negatives.
5. Expose a declared recipe through the same typed query/recipe system. Compare within-substrate or within-parent effects with explicit quantity/normalization policy and all alternatives. Keep pharmacological and reporter panels as separate endpoints. Do not infer parent abundance from fragment LFQ or use the selected publisher protein panel as a general denominator; independent precursor work stays in #757.

## Acceptance and limits

Provide an independently replayable coverage/admission ledger, original-source examples, exact versus surrogate material links, split constraints and immutable manifests. Before training, establish enough repeated observations to distinguish a perturbation response from acquisition variation; report unavailable metadata rather than guessing it. A negative coverage result is useful if it identifies exactly which assets/fields are missing.

These experiments would test a machinery-sensitive captured-product response and a known-substrate control. They do not directly label free intracellular concentration, total peptide yield, residence time, or independent peptide-specific MS/capture response. Keep those identification limits explicit and link additional calibration data requirements under #723. No author outreach is authorized by this issue alone.


The motivating [completed biological comparison and independent verification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/dccafe1/experiments/2026-10-22_2330_codex_mapp-biological-comparison/README.md) is now published in Presto commit `dccafe1`, including the negative held-out result and training-only evidence that the policy can fit the training objective. This issue remains a source-data request, not a claim that the proposed panels have already been recovered.

## Recovered controls and time-course outputs — October 23, 2026

[Completed source audit and immutable reproduction](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/dfe3af2/experiments/2026-10-23_0434_codex_mapp-controlled-admission/README.md). Both public processed archives are now fully downloaded, PRIDE-SHA1/size verified, and independently replayed. Do not repeat source discovery or treat these panels as unavailable.

| Source | Actual recovered coverage | Quantitative verification |
|---|---|---|
| PXD009508 | 6,060 peptide rows, 19,581 evidence rows, 18 runs; `alpha6`, `iso`, `gap` capture labels crossed with `ut`/`epoxo`, three numbered replicates per arm | All 109,080 peptide/run comparisons reproduce linked evidence sums within fixed rounding tolerance or are both zero |
| PXD007263 | 3,146 peptide rows, 27,196 evidence rows, 12 runs; `TNF-TP-0-6` labels with 0/1/2/6 and three replicate numbers | All 37,752 comparisons reproduce under the same policy |

All 30 deposited raw-file names map to actual summary/evidence rows. Ten original source tables and all 146,832 comparisons were independently checked using BSD tar extraction and a separate pandas aggregation by evidence `Peptide ID`. Complete inventories, row-level values/contributors, exact literal labels, failed attempts and hashes are published. Controls SHA256: `87d3711ad4a0e59d2618d079c2d6e95e14b8c544739701349d2b36bb4d5a14b8`; time course: `05e46c2be2bc6046a4dee1f264d2c4ffd5fd3cba821ae778ece8c34906e8dde4`.

### Concrete remaining shared-curation work

- Encode the controls' source-label mismatch explicitly: peptide column `1511_7181-300a_alpha6-ut_1` versus evidence/summary `1511_7181-300a_alpha6_ut1`. Unique punctuation aliases are supported by the full arithmetic audit, but are derived relations, not supplied specimen identities. Preserve both names and every contributor. The first strict-join failure is retained.
- Curate capture type separately from live-cell epoxomicin treatment and lysate-preservation inhibitors. Tie `alpha6`/`iso`/`gap` interpretations and paper-level dose/duration to cited source assertions; retain unknown run-specific specimen/aliquot links. Numbered repeats and the paper's replicate statement do not supply an exact material crosswalk.
- Preserve the time-course literal `TNF` labels alongside the paper's TNF-alpha plus IFN-gamma description. Resolve or explicitly scope that assertion before exposing a treatment default.
- Preserve source confidence and observation restrictions: PSM FDR 0.01 versus protein FDR 1; match-between-runs enabled; 7,136/12,131 `MULTI-MATCH` evidence rows; 400/500 evidence rows with unreported intensity. Reported zeros are not biological negatives, even though no filtered-zero/positive-evidence discrepancy occurs in these panels. Reverse, contaminant and ambiguous-parent rows remain discoverable and explicitly excluded by any training recipe.
- Recover/qualify the source sequence reference: the archives name `Human_UP_2016_02.fasta` but do not contain its bytes. Preserve original IDs/positions and reference-version uncertainty; do not silently replace it with a newer proteome.
- Materialize these sources and a declared recipe in the existing canonical query system, independently replay the export, then assess repeated-observation signal. Keep total detected signal and normalized composition separate: a unit-sum distribution cannot express a global inhibitor-associated decrease. Neither endpoint independently establishes molar intracellular abundance.

No Velcade- or ZsGreen-labeled run, or match to the four displayed reporter peptide sequences, was found in these **two selected processed panels**. That does not prove absence from all raw acquisitions; a human-only search reference is not a reporter-negative assay. Exact reporter construct/PRM quantities and Velcade run mappings remain open requests here. No author outreach occurred.

Complementary purified-protein quantitative time courses now have a separate source-specific owner, #770 (MSV000092631), including actual public file inventory and background/selection requirements. The recovered cellular inhibitor panel remains the immediate priority for this issue.


## Shared controls admission and training-only signal — October 23, 2026

[Immutable report, source snapshots and independent verification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/80ffa7e/experiments/2026-10-23_0645_codex_controlled-mapp-signal/README.md). Executed Hitlist1da88e6 now implements both recovered panels in the canonical query/recipe interface. All146,832 source quantities,900 missing evidence intensities,30 acquisition-label aliases, full contributors, scoped species/cell/treatment/capture assertions and all exact reference alternatives survive. The registered run recipe admits21,607 positive observations and retains125,225 excluded result decisions. Independent original-table/reference/query/recipe replay passes; all183 prior generation files remain byte-identical.

Training-only alpha6 repeatability has59 complete-case peptides across40 parent components, only2.56% of2,301 training peptides with any qualified positive signal. In nine leave-one-run-per-arm-out comparisons, peptide-specific empirical shifts improve RMSE from0.9031 to0.6761log10 units over a common shift; component-bootstrap MSE-improvement interval[0.1881,0.5552]. This is acquisition repeatability conditional on six runs, not a sequence-model test or causal concentration inference. Validation/test have14 complete-case peptides each; response outcomes remain unevaluated. The next matched exact/sampled fit is frozen separately.

The fixed59-peptide support retains epoxomicin/UT mean detected-signal ratio0.7119, whereas all qualifying observed training alpha6 signals have ratio0.2334. Selection, missingness and total yield cannot be collapsed into a single unit-sum target. Please retain any available per-run detection/quantification masks, threshold/LOD/LOQ/censor assertions, matching provenance and reasons for missing quantities; absent values must not become negatives. Independent precursor and MS-response requirements remain #757 and #762.

The implementation is a pushed draft candidate, not a released feature; parent stack/version reconciliation and current full hosted checks remain required. Format/lint/78 focused tests/strict docs pass; local full-suite memory guards refused before collection. Unresolved physical specimen/pairing, exact alpha6 gene mapping, TNF-versus-combined-cytokine scope, original2016 search FASTA, and reporter/Velcade source requests remain open here. No author outreach occurred.


## Completed controlled-response fit (2026-10-23)

[Full experiment, checkpoints and independent replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1110d49/experiments/2026-10-23_0721_codex_controlled-mapp-fit/README.md). The shared `mapp_controlled_complete_alpha6_response_v1` contrast at Hitlist0be964d preserves all prior run-export payloads and admits59/14/14 train/validation/test peptides. It requires three positive acquisitions in both untreated and epoxomicin arms and direct evidence in each arm; complete cases represent only2.56% of qualified training positives. All87 selected peptides and522 original run quantities independently replay.

Seven exact/REINFORCE32/128 fits, ridge and two controls completed locally. No fitted model beats the common-shift response control on both validation and test. Test log10 response RMSE: common shift0.63536, exact0.64789, sampled32mean0.64603, sampled128mean0.64421. Ridge0.62374 has worse validation error. All14,000 updates,28 checkpoints and870 predictions independently replay. Exact objective converges, yet training response RMSE worsens0.71048→0.81946 while reverse KL improves0.82458→0.53192. This identifies objective/measurement mismatch, not a requirement for more optimization or an established biological cause.

The cohort conditions on observed untreated quantities and both-arm detection; it does not measure intracellular concentration or unseen-product production. No model is promoted and no rescue tuning on the14 test peptides is planned. Known-substrate digestion time courses under #770 are the next source qualification. Missing specimen/precursor/capture-gene/selection metadata here remains unresolved. Source release reconciliation is separate from these immutable experimental inputs.
